---
title: "UnbalancedData"
output: html_document
---

```{r}
library(mosaic)
library(car)
library(emmeans)
library(pander)
library(tidyverse)
library(readr)
```

```{r}
cancer <- read_csv("../data/Cancer.csv")
View(cancer)
cancer$gender <- as.factor(cancer$gender)
```

```{r}
favstats(days ~ gender + type, data = cancer)
```

```{r}
cancer.aov <- aov(days ~ gender * type, data = cancer, contrasts = list(gender = contr.sum, type = contr.sum))
cancer.aov2 <- aov(days ~ type * gender, data = cancer, contrasts = list(gender = contr.sum, type = contr.sum))
summary(cancer.aov)
summary(cancer.aov2)
```

```{r}
car::Anova(cancer.aov, type = 3)
car::Anova(cancer.aov2, type = 3)
```

```{r}
can <- read_csv("../data/Cancer_10-24.csv")
View(can)
```

```{r}
favstats(days ~ gender + type, data = can)
```

```{r}
canaov <- aov(days ~ gender * type, data = can)
summary(canaov)
car::Anova(canaov, type = 3)

```

```{r}
par(mfrow = c(1, 3))
plot(canaov, which = 1)
plot(canaov, which = 2)
qqPlot(canaov$residuals)
```

```{r}
logcanaov <- aov(log(days) ~ gender * type, data = can)
summary(logcanaov)
```

```{r}
par(mfrow = c(1, 3))
plot(logcanaov, which = 1)
plot(logcanaov, which = 2)
qqPlot(logcanaov$residuals)
```



```{r}
sing <- read_csv("../data/singerheights.csv")
View(sing)
```

```{r}
favstats(height ~ gender + part, data = sing)
```

```{r}

summary(singaov)

```

```{r}
par(mfrow = c(1, 3))

```

```{r}

summary(logsingaov)
```

```{r}
par(mfrow = c(1, 3))
plot(logsingaov, which = 1)
plot(logsingaov, which = 2)
```
